market_data.price_source: MarketWatch delayed quote page; regular-session close used

investment_thesis.summary: Clean Harbors has the strongest specialized-waste operating momentum in the current ranking, supported by scarce treatment capacity, PFAS, remediation and field-services demand, but the current share price exceeds the modeled fair-value range and discounts substantial future growth.
return_engines: Specialized permitted treatment, hazardous disposal, PFAS and remediation demand
market_implied_assumptions: 2026 adjusted free cash flow remains near or above the $550 million midpoint of guidance.
Environmental Services retains high incinerator utilization and pricing.
PFAS and remediation demand remains durable rather than event-driven.
A meaningful portion of Safety-Kleen's current profitability remains sustainable.
An equity free-cash-flow multiple near 30x remains justified.
why_price_may_differ_from_value: The market is capitalizing multiple growth vectors simultaneously, including PFAS, remediation, scarce disposal capacity and field services.
The Q2 earnings beat and higher 2026 guidance increased confidence in near-term earnings.
Safety-Kleen's commodity-linked earnings uplift may be receiving a more durable valuation treatment than the fair scenario assumes.

conditions: Q3 adjusted EBITDA growth reaches or exceeds 24% to 28%.
PFAS and remediation growth remains broad-based.
Incinerator utilization remains near current high levels.
Adjusted free cash flow reaches approximately $620 million.
Adjusted free cash flow reaches the $550 million guidance midpoint.
Acquisition and growth-capital execution remains disciplined.
failure_conditions: Free cash flow falls below guidance
PFAS or disposal volumes weaken materially

conditions: Adjusted free cash flow falls to approximately $450 million.
failure_conditions: PFAS growth and incinerator utilization persist
Adjusted free cash flow remains above the current guidance midpoint

bull.method: 2026 adjusted free cash flow per share multiplied by a 31.0x equity FCF multiple

fair.method: 2026 adjusted free cash flow per share multiplied by a 27.0x equity FCF multiple

bear.method: 2026 normalized adjusted free cash flow per share multiplied by a 21.0x equity FCF multiple

valuation.explanation: The valuation uses adjusted equity free cash flow directly and does not separately add net cash. Clean Harbors' current $310 share price exceeds the $261-$298 modeled fair-value range. The principal valuation uncertainty is how much of Safety-Kleen's current commodity-linked profitability and PFAS-driven growth should receive a durable premium multiple.

catalysts.name: Q3 adjusted EBITDA growth of 24% to 28%
catalysts.scenario_impact: Would support the bull operating case if driven by durable Environmental Services demand.

catalysts.name: PFAS and remediation conversion
catalysts.scenario_impact: Supports utilization, pricing and specialized-waste growth.

catalysts.name: ES&H acquisition integration
catalysts.scenario_impact: Could increase field-services scale if acquisition returns meet expectations.

risks: PFAS or remediation demand proving event-driven
Acquisition and growth-capital returns below plan
invalidation_conditions: PFAS and remediation growth fails to persist beyond individual projects
Incinerator utilization declines materially from current levels
Adjusted free cash flow falls materially below the $520 million to $580 million guidance range
Acquisition or growth investments fail to generate adequate incremental returns
Safety-Kleen commodity benefits prove necessary to sustain the consolidated earnings profile

decision.summary: Clean Harbors has the strongest specialized-waste growth of the selected companies, but $310 is above the modeled $261-$298 fair-value range and 9.35% above the $281 fair value; wait for a better entry or materially higher sustainable free cash flow.
decision.next_catalyst: Q3 EBITDA delivery and evidence that PFAS and disposal growth remains structural rather than event-driven
required_actions: Track Environmental Services utilization and PFAS/remediation growth.
Separate Safety-Kleen commodity-spread benefits from structural earnings growth.
Track adjusted free cash flow against the $520 million to $580 million guidance range.
Monitor ES&H acquisition economics and incremental capital returns.

sources.title: Clean Harbors Announces Second-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
